title: Successor boundaries image le
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex and $F$ a decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration]. Let $r\ge1$, $D$ differential data on the concrete quotient page [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential], $i=(p,q)$ and $n=p+q$. Write $Z_s,B_s$ for its graded cycles and boundaries [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Suppose $h:Z_{r+1}^{p,q}\le Z_r^{p,q}$ and $f:Z_{r+1}^{p,q}\to D.\mathrm{page}.\mathrm{cycles}(i)$ satisfies $f\,\iota=\mathrm{incl}_h\,\pi_r$. Let $t:D.\mathrm{page}.X(\mathrm{prev}(i))\to D.\mathrm{page}.\mathrm{cycles}(i)$ be the incoming differential factored through the kernel. Then $f^{-1}(\operatorname{im}t)$ is the subobject of $Z_{r+1}^{p,q}$ represented by the inclusion $B_{r+1}^{p,q}\hookrightarrow Z_{r+1}^{p,q}$ [lem-sp-filtered-complex-boundaries-le-cycles]. The conclusion is the lhs ≤ rhs containment.

proof.text: Let b:B_r→Z_r and b':B_(r+1)→Z_r be the inclusions. Since b factors through b', the cokernel projection of b' descends to q:E_r→cokernel(b'). The new incoming-boundary-quotient theorem implies D.d(prev(pq),pq)≫q=0, because b'≫π_r≫q=b'≫cokernel.π(b')=0.

proof.text: Let P be the pullback of image(toCycles) under f. Its arrow composed with f factors through that image. The identity toCycles≫iCycles=D.d and the preceding vanishing show P.arrow≫f≫iCycles≫q=0. Rewrite using hf and π_r≫q=cokernel.π(b') to obtain P.arrow≫incl(Z_(r+1),Z_r)≫cokernel.π(b')=0. Abelian.monoLift factors this composite through b'. Finally b'=incl(B_(r+1),Z_(r+1))≫incl(Z_(r+1),Z_r); cancel the latter monomorphism to factor P.arrow through the former inclusion, which is the desired subobject inequality.

theorem filteredComplex_successor_boundaries_image_le
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hZ : F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) ≤
      F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r)
    (f : (F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) : C) ⟶ D.page.cycles pq)
    (hf : f ≫ D.page.iCycles pq =
        Subobject.ofLE _ _ hZ ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r pq) :
    (Subobject.pullback f).obj
      (imageSubobject (D.page.toCycles ((ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)).prev pq) pq)) ≤
      Subobject.mk (Subobject.ofLE _ _
        (filteredComplex_boundaries_le_cycles K F pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1)))
